# SD13-E5 Ranger level 10 THIRD-favored-enemy interval fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Ranger level 10 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It is the level-10 hybrid chassis baseline fixture with exactly two
# additional chosen selections, exercising the 10th-level "3rd favored enemy"
# interval that the level-10 chassis slice deliberately deferred (verified
# independently against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com: "At 5th level and
# every five levels thereafter (10th, 15th, and 20th level), the ranger may
# select an additional favored enemy. In addition, at each such interval, the
# bonus against any one favored enemy (including the one just selected, if so
# desired) increases by +2."):
#
#   choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_3:enemy:dragon
#     -- the additional favored enemy selected at the 10th-level interval,
#        mirroring choice:ranger_favored_enemy_2's open-ended recognition idiom
#   choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target_2:enemy:first
#     -- the 10th-level interval's OWN bonus-increase-target choice (each
#        interval grants its own +2 increase to any one favored enemy),
#        restricted to enemy:first | enemy:second | enemy:third; this fixture
#        names the first favored enemy again, stacking with the 5th-level
#        interval's increase already carried by the baseline fixture
#        (choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target:enemy:first), so
#        the first favored enemy's flat magnitude is +6 (2 base + 2 + 2)
#
# Everything else carries over from the level-10 baseline fixture unchanged.
# No target-type matching or conditional-application engine exists in this
# codebase, so no bonus is ever applied to an attack, damage, or skill total;
# the fixture makes no such claim.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level10-third-favored-enemy
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:10
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_2:enemy:undead
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_3:enemy:dragon
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target:enemy:first
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy_bonus_increase_target_2:enemy:first
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat:feat:point_blank_shot
